# Third-party runtime notices

This collection preserves the existing locally vendored Three.js and cannon-es runtimes used by the imported games. Their copyright/license headers remain in the files. The Three.js MIT license is included in `THREE-LICENSE.txt`.

The Pilot/Flying J names in the tanker prototype identify its educational subject. The prototype is not official or approved company, DOT, or hazmat training.

Original Python assets are retained in repository history and `python/`; browser classics render their own graphics and do not use those legacy assets.
